goal: Add an in-app feedback dialog reachable from the layout that POSTs message+category+context to /api/v1/feedback, verified against the mock-server.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Mock-server exposes POST /feedback: 201 {id,createdAt} for valid body, 400 for empty message
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: curl/supertest against npm run mock; node test or assert in e2e network log

acceptance_criteria.criterion: api.ts submitFeedback() builds the contract payload and surfaces 201 vs 400; unit-tested
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: vitest src/__tests__ for submitFeedback (mocked axios): 201 resolves, 400 rejects with ApiError

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Feedback button is reachable from AuthenticatedLayout on every page (no orphan route)
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: Playwright: button visible in layout on at least two routes

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Dialog validates empty message (cannot submit) and shows inline error
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: Playwright: open dialog, submit empty -> blocked + validation message

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Successful submit shows confirmation (sonner toast) and closes dialog; POST body carries auto context (module/path/appVersion)
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: Playwright: fill+submit -> toast + closed; assert intercepted POST /feedback body has context fields
npm test && npm run lint && npx tsc -b

tasks.desc: Add mock-server/routes/feedback.js (POST /feedback: validate message, 201 {id,createdAt}, 400 empty) and mount it in the mock app
Add submitFeedback(payload) to src/lib/api.ts with Feedback types in src/types; unit test in src/__tests__ (201 + 400)
Build FeedbackDialog component (shadcn Dialog + textarea + category select + optional contact), with sending/success/error states and sonner toast
Add a 'Enviar feedback' trigger in AuthenticatedLayout (sidebar/footer); auto-collect module/path (router) + appVersion + user (auth)
Write Playwright e2e feedback.spec.ts (smoke): visible trigger, empty validation, successful submit asserts intercepted POST body context
Run VERIFY_CMD + e2e; fix to green
